entities.name: Nur
entities.description: Nur is biologically demonic by birth, resulting from a demonic deal in 2003 where his father traded his life for Nur's existence. He chose humanity and ideological restraint over using his demonic instincts and power.
entities.quote: Nur is not like Khalid (contract-made). Not like Ethan/Elizah (fractured psyche + bloodline). Nur is biologically demonic by birth.

entities.name: Ethan
entities.description: Ethan serves as mentor and moral compass, being the first person who saw Nur as a human rather than a threat.
entities.quote: Ethan is not just a senior. He is: Mentor Moral compass First person who saw Nur as a human, not a threat

entities.name: Elizah
entities.description: A character seen as the strongest weapon, suffering from self-hatred.

entities.name: Aariz
entities.description: A character embodying instinct, ego, power, and dominance, fueled by an ego spiral from rejection.

timeline_events.title: The Mephisto Deal
timeline_events.description: Parents wanted a child and made a deal with Mephisto. The father could not complete the deal and his life was taken as payment, dying after Nur is born.
timeline_events.quote: The Mephisto deal in 2003: Parents wanted a child. Father couldn’t complete the deal. Payment wasn’t power, soul, or time — it was his life. He dies after Nur is born.
